# 2 Clement — Chapter 9 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 9
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Do not let anyone among you say that the body is not judged and will not be raised.
2. Think about it — how were you saved? How did you come to see? Was it not in and through this very body?
3. We must therefore treat our bodies as temples of God.
4. You were called in the flesh, and you will appear before God in the flesh.
5. Christ the Lord, who saved us — he was first Spirit, and then he became flesh. He called us in that form. So we too will receive our reward in the flesh.
6. Let us love one another, then, so that we may all reach the kingdom of God.
7. While we still have the chance to be healed, let us put ourselves in the hands of God our healer — and bring him his payment.
8. What is his payment? A genuinely repentant heart.
9. He knows everything ahead of time, and he knows what is in our hearts.
10. So let us praise him — not just with our lips but from the heart — so that he will receive us as his children.
